# CoreUI Data Grid JavaScript documentation

> High-performance data grid for CoreUI — 100,000 rows with sorting, filtering, selection and pagination.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/data-grid/docs/getting-started/introduction.md): High-performance data grid — 100,000 rows with sorting, filtering, selection, pagination, server-side data, column resizing, pinning, ordering and full theming, around 63 KB gzipped.
- [Installation](/data-grid/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Install CoreUI Data Grid via npm and load its stylesheet, or drop in the UMD bundle.
- [Quickstart](/data-grid/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Render your first CoreUI Data Grid in a few lines — columns, data, a stable row key, then your first feature.
- [Features](/data-grid/docs/getting-started/features.md): A capability matrix of everything CoreUI Data Grid does today, with the option that turns each feature on and a link to its docs.
- [Browsers & devices](/data-grid/docs/getting-started/browsers-devices.md): The browsers and devices CoreUI Data Grid supports, the floor it targets, and the browserslist configuration that drives its CSS prefixes and bundle syntax.

## AI Tools

- [LLMs.txt](/data-grid/docs/ai-tools/llms-txt.md): LLM-optimized documentation endpoints for CoreUI Data Grid — llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and a Markdown version of every page.
- [MCP Server](/data-grid/docs/ai-tools/mcp.md): Bring the CoreUI Data Grid documentation into your AI coding assistant with the @coreui/docs-mcp Model Context Protocol server.

## Features

- [Overview](/data-grid/docs/features/overview.md): A single kitchen-sink CoreUI Data Grid demo — 10,000 rows across fourteen columns with the toolbar, per-column filters, sizing, pinning, selection and a column chooser all turned on at once.
- [Virtualization](/data-grid/docs/features/virtualization.md): Row virtualization renders only the visible window of rows, so the Data Grid stays fast with 100,000 rows and beyond — sorting, filtering and selection run across the full dataset.
- [Sorting](/data-grid/docs/features/sorting.md): Sort the Data Grid by clicking a header, add multi-column sorting with shift+click, and opt individual columns out.
- [Filtering](/data-grid/docs/features/filtering.md): Filter the Data Grid with per-column filter dialogs (typed operators, AND/OR, set filter), a global search input, custom filter UIs and custom matching predicates.
- [Row reordering](/data-grid/docs/features/row-reordering.md): Let users drag rows into a new order with a per-row grip — the Data Grid hands you the reordered array and never mutates your data.
- [Row selection](/data-grid/docs/features/row-selection.md): Add a checkbox column to the Data Grid with select-all and shift+click range selection, keyed to a stable row id so selection survives sorting, filtering and paging.
- [Cell selection](/data-grid/docs/features/cell-selection.md): Spreadsheet-style cell ranges in the Data Grid — shift-click, drag and shift+arrows, with Ctrl/Cmd+C copying the range as tab-separated text ready to paste into Excel.
- [Keyboard navigation](/data-grid/docs/features/keyboard-navigation.md): APG grid keyboard navigation for CoreUI Data Grid — role="grid", a roving-tabindex active cell and arrow-key movement across header and data cells.
- [Inline editing](/data-grid/docs/features/editing.md): Inline cell editing for CoreUI Data Grid — built-in text, number and select editors, validation, and a popup contract for rich editors like date pickers and multi-selects.
- [Undo & redo](/data-grid/docs/features/history.md): Undo and redo inline-edit commits in the CoreUI Data Grid — toolbar buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y, with the app staying the single source of truth.
- [Save & restore state](/data-grid/docs/features/state.md): Persist the CoreUI Data Grid view — sorting, filters, column order, sizing, visibility, pinning, selection and page — to localStorage with a single option, or snapshot it programmatically.
- [Pagination](/data-grid/docs/features/pagination.md): Page through the Data Grid with a page-size selector, range info and CoreUI pagination controls instead of virtualized scrolling.
- [Server-side data](/data-grid/docs/features/server-side-data.md): Delegate sorting, filtering and pagination to your API with a single dataProvider function — the Data Grid fetches one debounced request per state change and drops stale responses.
- [Infinite scroll](/data-grid/docs/features/infinite-scroll.md): Load a server-side dataset page by page as the user scrolls — the Data Grid appends each page to the rows already in view and keeps virtualization on instead of switching to a pager.
- [Toolbar](/data-grid/docs/features/toolbar.md): Add a built-in Data Grid toolbar with a column chooser, CSV export button and global search — enabled with a single option or configured granularly.
- [Slots & custom rendering](/data-grid/docs/features/slots.md): Replace the Data Grid's toolbar, pagination and empty-state chrome with your own markup through the slots factory API.
- [Print](/data-grid/docs/features/print.md): Print the whole Data Grid — every sorted and filtered row, not the twenty the virtualizer has on screen or the page the user happens to be on.
- [CSV export](/data-grid/docs/features/csv-export.md): Export Data Grid rows to an RFC-4180 CSV string or file, with scope, delimiter, BOM and formula-injection sanitization options.
- [Excel export](/data-grid/docs/features/excel-export.md): Export Data Grid rows to a real .xlsx workbook — typed cells, a bold header row and column widths — from a dependency-free 3 KB subpath.

## Columns

- [Overview](/data-grid/docs/columns/overview.md): Define CoreUI Data Grid columns — keys, labels, cheap value formatting with formatter, and rich cell content with render.
- [Column sizing](/data-grid/docs/columns/sizing.md): Add drag-to-resize handles to Data Grid header cells, with live or on-release width updates and per-column opt-out.
- [Column pinning](/data-grid/docs/columns/pinning.md): Freeze Data Grid columns to the start or end edge so they stay visible while the rest of the grid scrolls horizontally.
- [Column ordering & visibility](/data-grid/docs/columns/ordering-visibility.md): Let users reorder Data Grid columns by drag-and-drop and hide or show columns through a column chooser.
- [Column menu](/data-grid/docs/columns/menu.md): Add a per-column header menu to the Data Grid that gathers sort, pin, move and hide actions behind one accessible ⋮ button, and customize its items with a builder.

## Customization

- [Styling & theming](/data-grid/docs/customization/styling.md): Theme the CoreUI Data Grid with --cui-data-grid-* CSS variables that resolve through CoreUI semantic tokens, so light and dark modes work with no extra CSS.
- [Localization](/data-grid/docs/customization/localization.md): Translate every CoreUI Data Grid UI string through the labels option, with {token} interpolation for dynamic values.
- [Feature sets](/data-grid/docs/customization/feature-sets.md): Pick the TanStack feature set your grid actually uses — the lite build covers sorting, filtering and pagination at 52 KB gzipped, the full build everything at 63 KB.

## Guides

- [Accessibility](/data-grid/docs/guides/accessibility.md): How CoreUI Data Grid supports keyboard interaction, ARIA roles and screen-reader announcements, and where the current limits are.
- [Performance](/data-grid/docs/guides/performance.md): How CoreUI Data Grid stays fast at 100,000 rows, the options that tune rendering, and when to move paging to your backend.
- [RTL](/data-grid/docs/guides/rtl.md): How CoreUI Data Grid behaves in right-to-left layouts — column order, reordering, resizing, keyboard direction and logical-property styling.

## API reference

- [Options](/data-grid/docs/api/options.md): Full reference of CoreUI Data Grid constructor options — columns, data, features and behavior.
- [Columns](/data-grid/docs/api/columns.md): Full reference of CoreUI Data Grid column definition keys — labels, sorting, filtering, formatting and custom rendering.
- [Events](/data-grid/docs/api/events.md): CoreUI Data Grid events — namespaced *.coreui.data-grid, each carrying structured state.
- [Methods](/data-grid/docs/api/methods.md): CoreUI Data Grid instance methods — selection, CSV export, updating options, disposal and the headless table getter.
- [Headless table](/data-grid/docs/api/headless.md): Drop down to the underlying headless table instance to build custom Data Grid UI and drive state imperatively.

## Resources

- [Roadmap](/data-grid/docs/resources/roadmap.md): What CoreUI Data Grid ships today and what is planned next — tree data, master-detail panels, a summary row, grouping and aggregation, and multi-level headers.
